column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row <sub>/opsteps/<id>/<i>. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable: the leader makes no call of the step, writes the result `fail` with the code `not_run` with the counters, the operation goes on; `retry-failed` does not copy such a step, the cause goes to the log
